es: Redactar un mensaje eficaz (de unas 110–130 palabras, que se lee en un minuto) con petición, razón, plazo y siguiente paso, usando enlaces concisos y reducción.

teaching.en: Could you lend us six tables for the street party on Saturday? We are going to run short of them, because the hall has only four.
teaching.es: ¿Podrían prestarnos seis mesas para la fiesta de la calle del sábado? Nos van a faltar, porque la sala solo tiene cuatro.
teaching.explanationEs: La petición va primero, en forma de pregunta breve con Could you. Run short of + nombre expresa que algo no alcanzará.
segments: Could you lend us six tables for the street party on Saturday? We
are going to run short of them, because the hall has only four.
teaching.audioText: Could you lend us six tables for the street party on Saturday? We are going to run short of them, because the hall has only four.

teaching.en: Please let me know no later than Thursday whether you are available and, if you can pitch in, what you could bring, since the caterer needs a final number.
teaching.es: Avísame a más tardar el jueves si estás disponible y, si puedes colaborar, qué podrías traer, ya que el catering necesita un número definitivo.
teaching.explanationEs: No later than + día marca un plazo firme; pitch in es colaborar con lo que cada uno pueda.
segments: Please let me know no later than Thursday whether you are available and, if you
can pitch in, what you could bring, since the caterer needs a final number.
teaching.audioText: Please let me know no later than Thursday whether you are available and, if you can pitch in, what you could bring, since the caterer needs a final number.

teaching.en: Always give a reason, but keep it short: the hall closes at ten, so we must arrange the chairs early, and one clear reason is enough.
teaching.es: Da siempre una razón, pero breve: la sala cierra a las diez, así que debemos organizar las sillas pronto, y una sola razón clara basta.
teaching.explanationEs: Una sola razón breve, con so o as, y nada de párrafos de justificación. Arrange significa organizar o disponer.
segments: Always give a reason, but keep it short: the hall closes at ten,
so we must arrange the chairs early, and one clear reason is enough.
teaching.audioText: Always give a reason, but keep it short: the hall closes at ten, so we must arrange the chairs early, and one clear reason is enough.

teaching.en: Please sign up today; otherwise, we cannot save you a seat, and I am sorry to ask on short notice.
teaching.es: Apúntate hoy; de lo contrario, no podemos guardarte un sitio, y lamento pedírtelo con tan poca antelación.
teaching.explanationEs: Otherwise advierte de la consecuencia en pocas palabras; on short notice pide disculpas por avisar tarde.
segments: Please sign up today; otherwise, we cannot save you a
seat, and I am sorry to ask on short notice.
teaching.audioText: Please sign up today; otherwise, we cannot save you a seat, and I am sorry to ask on short notice.

teaching.en: Next step: I will draw up the final list on Saturday and send it to everyone who has replied, so nobody is left guessing.
teaching.es: Siguiente paso: elaboraré la lista definitiva el sábado y la enviaré a todos los que hayan respondido, para que nadie se quede con dudas.
teaching.explanationEs: Next step cierra el mensaje con una acción concreta y su responsable. Draw up es redactar o preparar un documento.
segments: Next step: I will draw up the final list on Saturday and
send it to everyone who has replied, so nobody is left guessing.
teaching.audioText: Next step: I will draw up the final list on Saturday and send it to everyone who has replied, so nobody is left guessing.

teaching.en: Six tables needed, spare cables welcome; please rope in a few friends and get back to Ana with whatever you can offer before the weekend.
teaching.es: Se necesitan seis mesas y se agradecen cables de sobra; implica a algunos amigos y responde a Ana con lo que puedas ofrecer antes del fin de semana.
teaching.explanationEs: En notas y listas se omiten sujeto y verbo auxiliar: «needed» basta. Rope in es implicar a alguien para que colabore.
segments: Six tables needed, spare cables welcome; please rope in a few friends and
get back to Ana with whatever you can offer before the weekend.
teaching.audioText: Six tables needed, spare cables welcome; please rope in a few friends and get back to Ana with whatever you can offer before the weekend.

prompt.es: Ordena: «¿Podrías prestarnos seis mesas para el sábado?»

answer.text: Could you lend us six tables for Saturday

feedback.es: La petición se formula con Could you + verbo base, y lo prestado y el plazo van después.

prompt.es: Completa: «Responde a más tardar el jueves a mediodía; si no, no te guardamos sitio.»

feedback.es: No later than + día es la fórmula para un plazo firme; by sería más suave, pero no encaja con este hueco.

hint.es: Es la palabra negativa que va antes de «later than».

origin.text: The caterer needs a final number. Please reply ___ later than Thursday noon; otherwise, we cannot save you a seat.

prompt.es: Elige el mensaje que abre con la petición y deja la razón y el plazo después.

choices.text: We have only ten chairs, and thirty people are coming on Saturday, which is why I am writing. Could you bring some? Please reply by Friday.
Hello! I hope you are all well. Last year we also held a party and it was lovely, so this year we thought of doing it again.
Could you bring chairs on Saturday? We have only ten and thirty people are coming. Please reply no later than Friday.

feedback.es: El primer mensaje empieza por lo que se pide y sigue con la razón y el plazo; el segundo contiene lo mismo, pero deja la petición para después.

hint.es: La petición va primero; la razón y el plazo, después.

prompt.es: ¿Qué versión pide lo mismo con menos palabras y sigue siendo cortés?

choices.text: Could you tell me by Thursday whether you are available?
Could you possibly let me know, by the end of the day on Thursday, if it is at all possible that you will be available?
Please advise regarding your availability, which I would like to know before Thursday arrives.

feedback.es: La primera pide lo necesario con el plazo en una sola frase; las otras añaden palabras sin añadir información.

origin.text: Draft: I am writing to you with the purpose of requesting that you inform me, at your earliest convenience, regarding whether you will be available on Thursday.

prompt.es: Completa: «Se necesitan veinte sillas; las de sobra son bienvenidas.»

feedback.es: En una nota se omiten are y el resto: Twenty chairs needed basta para informar.

origin.text: Notice on the hall door: twenty chairs ___; spare ones welcome. Please speak to Ana if you can lend some.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué espera Sara de quien escucha.

choices.text: The speakers delivered to the hall on Wednesday.
An answer by Wednesday about lending the speakers.
Help finding out why the hall has no speakers.

feedback.es: Sara pide una respuesta a más tardar el miércoles; los altavoces son para el sábado y el colegio es el plan B.

origin.audio: Hi, it's Sara. Could you lend us two speakers for Saturday? The hall has none. I'm sorry to ask on short notice, but we only found out today. Please tell me no later than Wednesday; otherwise, I'll ask the school.

prompt.es: Escribe el mensaje (unas 110–130 palabras): petición, razón, plazo y siguiente paso.

answer.text: Hi neighbours, we are organising the street party on Saturday at five, and we need your help. Could anyone lend us twelve chairs? We only have eight, and twenty people are coming, so we will run short of seats otherwise. Please let me know no later than Thursday whether you are available, because the school has offered to lend us some if we ask in time. I know this is on short notice, but if you can pitch in, I am grateful for any help. Next step: I will draw up the final list on Friday and send it to everyone who has replied. Please get back to me if anything changes. Thank you for your help, and please rope in a few friends too.
accepted: Hi neighbours, we are organising the street party on Saturday at five, and we need your help. Could anyone lend us twelve chairs? We only have eight, and twenty people are coming, so we will run short of seats otherwise. Please let me know no later than Thursday whether you are available, because the school has offered to lend us some if we ask in time. I know this is on short notice, but if you can pitch in, I am grateful for any help. Next step: I will draw up the final list on Friday and send it to everyone who has replied. Please get back to me if anything changes. Thank you for your help, and please rope in a few friends too.

Hello everyone, the street party is on Saturday at five, and I need a favour. Can you lend us twelve chairs, please? We have only eight, and twenty people are coming, so we will run short of seats. Please get back to me no later than Thursday if you are available, because the school could lend us some, but only if I ask in time. Sorry to ask on short notice; if you can pitch in, any help is very welcome. Next step: on Friday I will draw up the final list and send it to everybody who has answered. Tell me if anything changes. Thanks a lot, and please rope in a friend or two.

Dear neighbours, our street party is on Saturday at five, and we would be grateful for your help. Could someone lend us twelve chairs? We have only eight chairs and twenty people are coming, so we are going to run short. Please reply by Thursday to say whether you are available; otherwise, I will ask the school, which will need notice. I am sorry to ask on short notice, and if you can pitch in, I appreciate any help you can give. Next step: I will draw up the final list on Friday and send the final list to everyone who replied. Do get back to me if your plans change. Thank you very much, and please rope in a few friends as well.

feedback.es: El mensaje sigue el orden petición, razón, plazo y siguiente paso, con conectores breves y una sola razón clara.

origin.text: Fiesta de la calle: el sábado a las cinco. Necesitas doce sillas más: solo tienes ocho y vienen veinte personas. Pide que te las presten. Plazo para responder: el jueves; el colegio podría prestarlas, pero hay que avisar a tiempo. Pide disculpas por avisar con poca antelación. Siguiente paso: enviarás la lista definitiva el viernes y pides que te avisen si algo cambia.

prompt.es: Lee la respuesta de la vecina: ¿qué da a entender?

choices.text: She would rather not help but finds it hard to refuse.
She will lend the chairs as soon as she has tidied up.
She is willing to help but cannot guarantee it in time.

feedback.es: La vecina quiere ayudar, pero dice que no puede prometer nada y pide que le avisen si llega tarde: ofrece ayuda sin garantizarla.

origin.text: Hi Ana, thanks for the message. I'd love to help, but my chairs are all in the garage, which is a mess at the moment. I might be able to get them out by Friday, though I can't promise. Let me know if that's too late.

prompt.es: Completa: «Lamento pedírtelo con poca antelación, pero la sala solo confirmó hoy.»

feedback.es: On short notice (o at short notice, en inglés británico) es la colocación para avisar con poca antelación.

origin.text: I know you have plans this weekend. I am sorry to ask ___ short notice, but the hall only confirmed the booking today.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Responde a más tardar el viernes al mediodía, por favor.»

answer.text: Please get back to me no later than Friday noon

feedback.es: Get back to + persona es responder, y no later than + día marca el plazo; please suaviza la petición.

prompt.es: Lee el mensaje de Ana: ¿para qué menciona que el colegio cobra por las sillas?

choices.text: To give neighbours a reason to reply before Thursday.
To complain that the school charges too much.
To ask the neighbours to pay the school's charge.

feedback.es: Ana explica que, si nadie responde, tendrá que pedirlas al colegio y eso cuesta: es una razón para que respondan a tiempo, no una queja ni una petición de dinero.

origin.text: Hi everyone, it is Ana from number twelve. Could anyone lend us twelve chairs for the street party on Saturday? We only have eight, and twenty people are coming. Please get back to me no later than Thursday, because otherwise I will have to ask the school, and they charge for it. Next step: I will draw up the final list on Friday. If you are wondering, the party started years ago as a small picnic, and I still think that is why it works: everyone brings something.

prompt.es: Completa: «Se necesitan seis mesas; se agradecen cables de sobra.»

feedback.es: Spare significa de sobra o de repuesto: los cables que tengas de más son bienvenidos.

origin.text: The notice is short on purpose: six tables needed; ___ cables welcome. Please get back to Ana before the weekend.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué da a entender Leo con su último comentario.

choices.text: That he will chase each person who has not replied.
That a low turnout could make the trip dearer for everyone.
That the train is cheaper than the coach would have been.

feedback.es: Si la lista sigue corta cancelará el autobús y todos pagarán más por el tren: es una advertencia sutil para que la gente responda.

origin.audio: Hi, Leo here. A quick one about the trip: we need a final number by Monday, and I've only heard from six people so far. I'm not going to chase anyone, but if the list stays this short, I'll have to cancel the coach, and then we'll all pay more for the train.
